name: Reading Gods Word
overview: Scripture reveals the vital importance of God's Word as both spiritual sustenance and guidance for believers. Jesus affirms that life depends not on physical bread alone but on every word from God's mouth, emphasizing the Word's sustaining power (Matthew 4:4). The psalmist treasures God's commands above all else, hiding them in the heart to avoid sin and relying on the Word as a lamp illuminating the believer’s path (Psalms 119:11, 105; Job 23:12). Moreover, the apostle Paul highlights that the Scriptures were written for our instruction and encouragement, providing hope through their patient study (Romans 15:4). At the foundation, the Word is divine, existing eternally with God and as God Himself (John 1:1), underscoring the sacredness and authority of Scripture in the believer’s life.
